title: Knowledge map
subtitle_topics: Knowledge points by topic: concepts, decisions, how-tos, pitfalls, facts
subtitle_projects: Each project: the main chat’s goal and notes, plus its curated summary
empty_topics_body: In the background, Persona pulls durable knowledge out of your project timelines and chats and files it under topics. The map fills in as it goes.
empty_off_body: Turn on “Organize knowledge points by topic” in Settings › Knowledge, and Persona starts curating them in the background.
empty_projects_body: Projects appear as Persona sorts them out of your chats and Agents’ work.
topics_about: Knowledge Persona pulled out of project timelines (the main chat’s notes and each Agent turn’s summary) and chats, filed by subject rather than by project: concepts, decisions and their reasons, how-tos, pitfalls, facts and open questions. Progress and status stay on the project pages.
projects_about: For each project, what the main chat keeps (goal, role, status, importance and its own timeline notes) and the summary the background curation writes, by section. Notes are counted over each project’s latest 30 timeline lines. Agents’ automatic lines are on the project page.
no_summary: No curated summary yet; the background curation writes one when the project has news.
no_notes: No main chat notes in the latest timeline.
